headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2026: FTR vs. Davis & Doyle went to battle over the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.42. For Davis & Doyle, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. It was the 90th time the AEW World Tag Team Titles had been on the line, a genuinely rare milestone for that title. FTR retained the AEW World Tag Team Championship over Don Callis Family's Mark Davis and Jake Doyle, with Jon Moxley's interference proving decisive.
Turning the clock back to 2026: Andrade El Idolo vs. Swerve Strickland headlined Dynamite, rated 8.17 ? a real highlight of the night.

On this day in 2026, Mark Briscoe vs. El Clon put the AEW TNT Title on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.11 ? a good, competitive contest. For El Clon, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2026, when Kris Statlander vs. Thekla clashed for the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.20 ? a well-worked match.
2026 brought us this moment: Ace Austin returned to the fold after 6 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.
